description: This file defines an interface for a persistent grain in Orleans, extending a simple grain interface with additional asynchronous methods for settings and retrieving state information.

classes.name: ISimplePersistentGrain
classes.description: An interface representing a persistent grain extending the ISimpleGrain with additional state management methods.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets a value 'a' and a deactivate flag for the grain.

methods.name: GetVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the grain as a GUID.

methods.name: GetRequestContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current request context as an object.

methods.name: SetRequestContext
methods.description: Sets the request context with provided data.
